messages:
Maya (People Ops): Announcing a small org tweak + hiring plan: Katrina Lopez will join as Senior Director, Capacity & Runtime Strategy on Sept 6. This centralizes capacity planning and cross-region routing policies. Were running a short 7-day internal window for a Principal Capacity Planner (L5) and need a 4-week rotation lead for capacity testing. Details below.

Diego (VP Product): Welcome Katrina! Consolidation should help roadmap alignment between product SLAs and infra spend.

Katrina Lopez: Hi all  excited to join. Week 1 I'll read the last quarter's capacity reports and the cost playbook. I'll also schedule office hours for infra + product partners.

Omar (Eng Manager - Platform): For the L5 Principal Planner backfill, internal candidates preferred through Apr 11. Need experience with autoscaling policies, rack-aware placement, and multi-region traffic shaping.

Lina (Talent): Internal application link: <https://company.internal/hiring/capacity-principal-l5>  please include a one-line summary of relevant capacity projects. Internal window closes Apr 11.

Ben (Eng Lead, Observability): Who will own capacity alerts during the handoff? We should avoid alert storming during the transition.

Maya (People Ops): Short answer: Observability remains with Eng Platform but Katrina will have dotted-line ownership of capacity SLOs for the first 90 days. Well publish a transition checklist.

Sam (SRE): I can take rotation lead for capacity testing for 4 weeks starting Sept 6 if that helps. Will prepare the test harness and a runbook.

Anita (People Ops Bot): Calendar events created: "Katrina intro  capacity all-hands" (Sept 7) and "Capacity hiring panel" (Apr 15). Invitations sent to Platform, Runtime, SRE, Product.

Maya (People Ops): Action items recap:
- Lina: open internal L5 window & link (due Apr 11)
- Omar: hiring rubric + interviewers (by Apr 13)
- Katrina: office hours week of Sept 9 (signup sheet to follow)
- Sam: provisional rotation lead & test harness (confirm by Aug 20)
- People Ops: publish transition checklist and dotted-line guidance (by Apr 14)

If youre nominating someone internally, DM Lina. Please react with :tada: if you saw this.
